title: Two Weeks in Portugal (2016 Trip Fragments)

items.name: Flight to Faro
items.details: Flew from Berlin to Faro to start the two-week trip.

items.name: Train to Olhao
items.details: Took the train from Faro to Olhao, then walked to the city port to catch the ferry.

items.name: Ferry to Armona
items.details: Many ferries run from Olhao to Armona; only a 15-minute ride.

items.name: Airbnb on Ilha de Armona
items.details: Airbnb on the tiny, beautiful island of Armona; long stretches of beach, a few seafood restaurants, a small convenience store; grocery shopping at the big farmers market in Olhao.

items.name: Camping on Berlengas
items.details: Spent 36 hours camping on the island; ferry from Peniche harbor (20 minutes); season runs May 20 to September 15; reservations with Viamar by calling (+351) 262 785 646 or at kiosks at the ferry harbor.

items.name: Camping Acqua Dolce
items.details: Campsite in the town of Levanto used as the base for visiting Cinque Terre; small town they loved and would recommend.

items.name: Coastal hike Levanto to Monterosso
items.details: First and favorite portion of the hike, from Levanto to Monterosso - peaceful with hardly anyone on the trail.

items.name: Cinque Terre day pass trains
items.details: The Cinque Terre day card lets you ride as many trains as you want to navigate between towns (but does not cover the boat trip).

items.name: Paid coastal trail hike
items.details: The Monterosso to Vernazza section is the only trail you have to pay for; described as a little pricey but the money goes to trail upkeep; trail was very crowded but the views of Vernazza from the top were breathtaking.

items.name: Ferry to Riomaggiore
items.details: Recommended especially when visiting Riomaggiore because it gives a completely different perspective.

title: Tara Milk Tea's Europe trip highlights (Mykonos and Budva)

items.name: Cavo Tagoo
items.details: Boutique hotel on a hillside overlooking the water near Hora, Mykonos; stayed four nights. Big lunch at the hotel's excellent restaurant with friends - fresh seafood such as marinated octopus and ceviche; breakfast described as one of the best buffets she has experienced; meals by the pool overlooking the ocean; rooms with ocean views

items.name: Dukely Beach Lounge
items.details: Beautiful spot in Budva with incredible views; perfect for unwinding in the late afternoon; unexpectedly excellent Japanese food - large sushi platter, fried octopus and saffron risotto

items.name: Air Berlin
items.details: Flew from Duesseldorf to Abu Dhabi with Air Berlin in the evening; travel organized via LTUR (thanked on the blog).

items.name: Desert Safari
items.details: Diary Day 1 title: 'Camel Kisses, Desert Safari & City Tour'.

items.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
items.details: Tip: go right before sunset for the most stunning scenes; wear something long (free cover-up rental available at the entrance).

items.name: Sand Boarding
items.details: Sand boarding tried out during the desert safari: 'looks easier than it really is but a lot of fun'.

items.name: Ferrari World
items.details: Tip: go for a ride on the fastest rollercoaster in the world; only two members of her group had time to see it.

items.name: Yas Mall shopping
items.details: Diary Day 2: mosque + Yas Mall; tip: cool stores include Victoria's Secret, Pink, Bath & Body Works and many restaurants.

items.name: Formula 1 race with evening fireworks
items.details: Diary Day 3: 'Formula 1 Race, Fireworks & Cheesecake Factory'.

items.name: Cheesecake Factory
items.details: Her favorites: Oreo Dream Extreme Cheesecake and Ultimate Red Velvet Cheesecake. 'Also all other food is amazing there.'

items.name: Taxis (cash only)
items.details: Transport tips: only enter taxis with a working taximeter (drivers took detours or overcharged); taxis are cheap but cash-only - withdraw enough cash beforehand (four ATMs ran out of cash on F1 race day).

items.name: Arrival at Honolulu International Airport
items.details: Arrived late afternoon at Honolulu International Airport.

items.name: Rental car
items.details: Reserved the cheapest car online (a Ford Focus) and got a black Mustang instead at a 'super cheap price'.

items.name: Duke's
items.details: Dinner recommendation; 'definitely try out some local Hawaiian food such as Poké'.

items.name: Kayak to Chinaman's Hat
items.details: Woke up early, drove to Kualoa Regional Park and kayaked to Chinaman's Hat - 'Definitely go there!'.

items.name: Lanikai Beach
items.details: Named in the Day 1-2 trip post title alongside the kayak excursion.

items.name: Onward to Maui
items.details: 'We will stay on Oahu the next days before we'll be heading to Maui' - the diary series continued to Maui.

title: New Zealand: Nelson & Abel Tasman Travel Tips
destination: Nelson and Abel Tasman National Park

items.name: Air New Zealand
items.details: 'Flying makes definitely sense' - much more comfortable and faster than the ferry to Nelson.

items.name: Boat Shed
items.details: Visited twice; seafood (shrimp salad is 'amazing'), cheesecake with berries for dessert; terrace overlooking the sailing club at the harbour.

items.name: World of Wearable Art museum
items.details: 'Even my taste' although she's 'not a fan of museums' - designer fashion pieces on display.

items.name: Nelson city and sailing harbour
items.details: Explore the city (stores, restaurants) and stop at the beautiful sailing harbour.

items.name: Abel Tasman Marahau Lodge
items.details: 'Sweet hotel, isn't very luxurious but really nice' - breakfast served to the room; walking distance to the park, water taxi and kayaking.

items.name: Cullans Point Lookout hike
items.location: Anchorage Beach, Abel Tasman National Park
items.details: 'Bring good shoes and explore the park on foot'; around 40-minute hike from Anchorage Beach to the lookout with lovely beach views.

items.name: Kayaking with Abel Tasman Kayaks
items.details: Booked the full-day tour (almost entire day) with a group of ~10; 'the guides are really amazing'.

items.name: Aqua Packers
items.details: Boat hostel near Anchorage Beach; single rooms available (not only shared); barbecue dinner on the boat with other travellers.

items.name: Water Taxi
items.details: 'Via Water Taxi you can get from one island to the other if you don't wanna walk the entire time.'

title: Mysterious Mongolia: self-drive 4x4 adventure with Follow The Tracks

items.name: Self-drive 4x4 Mongolia trip (Follow The Tracks)
items.details: Billed as the first self-drive 4x4 trip through Mongolia; takes you and your friends to incredible places away from tourist spots, deeply immersed in the culture of the country

items.name: Local nomad family homestay
items.details: Stayed with local nomad families during the trip

items.name: Visit Eagle Hunting families
items.details: Stayed with the Eagle Hunting families during the trip

items.name: Camel-breeding Mongolian family homestay
items.details: Stayed with the camel-breeding Mongolian families during the trip

items.name: Diocletian's Palace
items.details: Stroll the fourth-century palace halls, now lined with cafes and shops

items.name: St. Duje's Cathedral
items.details: Don't-miss cathedral inside Diocletian's Palace

items.name: Klis Fortress
items.details: Fortress featured in Game of Thrones

items.name: Museum of Croatian Archaeological Monuments
items.details: Home to some 20,000 relics and artifacts

items.name: Carpe Diem
items.details: World-famous clubbing spot Hvar Town is known for

items.name: Stari Grad
items.details: UNESCO-listed quieter old town on opposite side of island; hike olive groves and lavender fields

items.name: Vis / Korcula / Mljet day trip
items.details: Day trip to one of three islands; Vis is untouched (off-limits to civilians until 1989), Korcula for Marco Polo old town and posip wine, Mljet for forests and national park

items.name: Dubrovnik city walls
items.details: Walk the famous city walls

items.name: Mt. Srd cable car
items.details: Cable car to top of Mt. Srd for views of the historic city (runs April-December)

items.name: 17th-century cathedral and 15th-century clock tower
items.details: Don't-miss historic landmarks

items.name: Lokrum island day trip
items.details: Swim and hike to escape the crowds

items.name: Split to Dubrovnik sailing trip
items.details: Alternative way to do the week: 7-day sailing trip (chartered or hop-on hop-off) Split to Dubrovnik

title: Itinerary for Two Weeks in Morocco

items.name: Fly into Marrakech Menara Airport
items.details: Fly into Marrakech to start the trip

items.name: Riad Yasmine
items.details: Gorgeous riad; two-night stay covering Days 1-2; described as one of Instagram's most famous hotels

items.name: NOMAD
items.details: Cool fusion restaurant for dinner on the first night; great food and an epic sunset view

items.name: Ben Youssef Madrasa and Bahia Palace
items.details: Both perfect for photo ops

items.name: Le Jardin
items.details: Green oasis in the middle of the city; perfect midday break; pop-up shop inside

items.name: Buy a local Maroc SIM card
items.details: Maroc SIM card: 40 dirham (~$4 USD) plus 100 dirham (~$10 USD) for 10GB of data

items.name: Shop Jemaa el Fna markets
items.details: Shopping at Jemaa el Fna - noted as overly touristy with aggressive vendors

items.name: La Mamounia
items.details: Famous luxury hotel for the last couple of nights in the city (Days 3-4); a place to unwind and indulge

items.name: Drive Marrakech to the Sahara Desert
items.details: Approx. 10-hour drive; driver booked through the desert camp

items.name: Sahara Desert Luxury Camp
items.details: Two unforgettable nights of glamping (Days 5-6); travel/driver included in the glamping package

items.name: Transfer from Sahara Desert Camp to Skoura Valley Oasis
items.details: 5-hour transfer in a 4x4 with the private driver from the desert camp

items.name: L'ma Lodge
items.details: One-night stay (Days 7-8)

items.name: Drive to Essaouira
items.details: Approx. 7-hour drive with the driver from the desert camp

items.name: Villa Maroc
items.details: Two-night stay (Days 8-9); book a massage and spend time in their hammam

items.name: Explore the Medina and souks
items.details: Endless souks - schedule time and budget for shopping

items.name: Stroll the port and fish market
items.details: Huge port with bright blue boats; head to the bustling fish market afterwards

items.name: Take a cooking class
items.details: Learn to make traditional Moroccan dishes; offered by Villa Maroc

items.name: La Licorne
items.details: Fine dining experience; try their tajin and couscous dishes

items.name: Taxi to Marrakech
items.details: Taxi to Marrakech paid approx. $90 USD

items.name: Overnight train from Marrakech to Tangier
items.details: Overnight train, one night; a great way to see the landscape between cities

items.name: Taxi to Chefchaouen
items.details: Just over two hours; $60 USD

items.name: Dar Baibou
items.details: Two-night stay (Days 11-13); quaint hotel with traditional Moroccan style and great amenities

items.name: Casa Perleta (alternative)
items.details: Alternative top-rated hotel with Andalusian style; very popular so book early; beignet stand right next door

items.name: Hike to the Spanish Mosque
items.details: Overlooking Chefchaouen; plan a couple of hours to hike up and explore the abandoned mosque

items.name: Le Lamp Magique at Aladins
items.details: Popular for classic lunch dishes and one of the prime places in Chefchaouen to watch the sunset; favourite shop nearby was La Botica de la Abuela Aladdin for homemade soaps

items.name: Taxi to Fes
items.details: Approx. 3.5 hours

items.name: Visit the tanneries
items.details: Very sensory tour of the famous leather tanneries (lots of strong smells); beautiful handmade leather pieces; best overhead view of the souk and tanneries from the stairs of Shop 64

items.name: Explore Al Attarine Madrasa
items.details: Educational institute in the heart of the medina; interesting history and intricate architecture; worth the quick tour

items.name: Dar Seffarine
items.details: Oldest hotel in the medina with just six guest rooms; intimate feel and a nice escape from the busy streets

items.name: Train to Casablanca
items.details: Less than four hours; $12 to $25 USD depending on seats

items.name: Mogador Marina
items.details: One-night stay (Days 14-15)

items.name: Rick's Cafe
items.details: A classic; they make a great Negroni

items.name: Visit the Hassan II Mosque
items.details: Incredible mosque sitting above the Atlantic Ocean, visible through one room's glass floor

items.name: Bennis Habous pastry shop
items.details: Located near the old medina; often considered one of the best pastry shops in the country; try the hornes des gazelles

items.name: Resto Zayna
items.details: Very traditional Moroccan experience and a taste of the country's traditional cuisine

items.name: Stroll through Parc de La Ligue Arabe
items.details: Peaceful area full of greenery; ideal spot for a walk

items.name: Sundance
items.details: Took the chairlift to the top and cruised around; kids loved the chairlift; hikes and trails in summer, skiing in winter.

items.name: Fifth Water Hot Springs hike
items.details: Great family hike up Diamond Fork Canyon ending at sulphur-y hot pots; about a 3-hour round trip.

items.name: Stand-up paddle boarding at Payson Lakes
items.details: With Epic Recreation; a huge family-sized paddle board.

items.name: Rowley's Red Barn
items.details: Family business with hay rides, fruit picking (apples, peaches, cherries), fresh produce store; try the fresh apple juice and apple slushy float.

items.name: Holdman Studios
items.details: Glass blowing and stained-glass art studio of Tom Holdman.

items.name: Farm Country
items.details: Family farm experience; kids ride ponies and see cows, rabbits, horses, turkeys, goats and baby chicks.

items.name: The Light of the World Garden
items.details: Peaceful garden with fifteen pieces depicting parables and miracles of Christ.

items.name: Aubergine restaurant
items.details: Welcoming owners the family called out as a highlight.

title: South Island Road Trip - Part 1 (Christchurch to Queenstown)

items.name: Flight to Christchurch
items.details: Flew from Queenstown to Christchurch to start the trip; picked up the campervan at Christchurch airport.

items.name: Britz Campervan
items.details: Britz campervan, the group's wheels for the trip.

items.name: The Clink
items.details: Hip restaurant in Sumner, Christchurch, in a building that once housed mutineers from an English settling mission; dinner on arrival night.

items.name: Castle Hill
items.details: Limestone boulder field at the foothills of the Southern Alps, 2 hours from Christchurch; film location for the final battle of the Chronicles of Narnia; visited at sunrise.

items.name: Devil's Punchbowl falls and kea spotting
items.details: Waterfall walk in Arthur's Pass; saw cheeky kea, the world's only alpine parrot, at a high viewpoint.

items.name: Monteith's Brewery tour
items.details: Brewery tour in Greymouth - learned the story behind the classic kiwi beer brand, how it is brewed, plus tasting.

items.name: Te Waonui Forest Retreat
items.details: 5-star luxury lodge in Franz Josef; her room followed by a 5-course degustation menu at the on-site restaurant.

items.name: Canopy Restaurant
items.details: 5-course degustation dinner at the Te Waonui Forest Retreat, including raspberry sorbet served in bubbles.

items.name: Glacier helicopter scenic flight and landing
items.details: Scenic helicopter flight out to Fox Glacier, landing on a big ice field, then flying back over Franz Josef glacier.

items.name: Haast Pass drive
items.location: Fox Glacier to Wanaka via Haast Pass
items.details: Drove the Haast Pass from Fox Glacier to Wanaka; build in extra time for waterfall and glacial river stops.

items.name: Whare Kea Chalet
items.details: Luxury alpine lodge high on Dragonfly Peak, reached by helicopter; dinner, wine and stargazing under a full moon.

items.name: Nomad Safaris Macetown trip
items.details: Backcountry 4WD trip up to Macetown with river crossings and deep green and gold gorges.

items.name: Amisfield winery
items.details: Final lunch of the trip at the winery near Queenstown before the group flew home.
